# curl — 2022 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 2 curl CVEs of 2022 are in `data/cve/vendors/curl/2022.jsonl`.

### CVE-2022-27780
- Assigner: hackerone | Published: 2022-06-01 | Updated: 2026-10-14 | Max CVSS: 5.3
- CWE: CWE-177 Improper Handling of URL Encoding (Hex Encoding) (CWE-177)
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 5.3 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

The curl URL parser wrongly accepts percent-encoded URL separators like '/'when decoding the host name part of a URL, making it a *different* URL usingthe wrong host name when it is later retrieved.For example, a URL like `http://example.com%2F127.0.0.1/`, would be allowed bythe parser and get transposed into `http://example.com/127.0.0.1/`. This flawcan be used to circumvent filters, checks and more.
